scheme_name: Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
description:
The Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the families of construction workers who have lost their lives due to accidents. 

The scheme also extends support to differently-abled individuals who are part of the construction workforce. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased construction workers receive adequate financial support during their time of distress. 

The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial assistance of INR 2 lakh to the families of deceased construction workers. 

This assistance is intended to help the families cope with the immediate financial burden following the loss of their primary breadwinner. 

In addition to the financial assistance for deceased workers, the scheme also provides support for differently-abled individuals. 

Differently-abled construction workers can receive a financial assistance of INR 1 lakh under this scheme. 

This support is aimed at helping them with their rehabilitation and ensuring their continued livelihood. 

The eligibility criteria for the Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana are specific and clearly defined. 

To be eligible for the scheme, the applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act, 1996. 

The applicant must also provide proof of their registration with the relevant state welfare board. 

In the case of deceased workers, the applicant must be a family member of the deceased worker. 

The family member must provide valid documentation proving their relationship to the deceased. 

For differently-abled individuals, they must provide a certificate of disability issued by a competent authority. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward and involves several steps. 

Interested applicants must first visit the official website of the respective state welfare board. 

They should download the application form specific to the Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana. 

The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents. 

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of registration as a construction worker, and proof of relationship to the deceased worker. 

For differently-abled individuals, a disability certificate must also be submitted. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the relevant authorities. 

The processing time for applications may vary but is generally completed within 30 days. 

Disbursement of the financial assistance is made directly to the bank account of the eligible beneficiary. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

State welfare boards are responsible for the execution and monitoring of the scheme at the state level. 

The Ministry of Labour and Employment can be contacted for any inquiries regarding the scheme. 

The contact details for the ministry are available on their official website. 

The Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana is part of a broader initiative to support the construction workforce in India. 

The construction sector is one of the largest employers in India, providing jobs to millions of workers. 

However, it is also a sector that poses significant risks to workers' health and safety. 

The scheme aims to address the vulnerabilities faced by construction workers and their families. 

According to the Ministry of Labour and Employment, there are over 50 million registered construction workers in India. 

The scheme is expected to benefit a substantial number of families who face financial hardships due to the loss of a family member. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is intended to cover immediate expenses such as funeral costs and other urgent needs. 

The support for differently-abled individuals is also crucial in promoting inclusivity within the workforce. 

The scheme emphasizes the importance of ensuring that differently-abled individuals have access to financial support for their rehabilitation. 

The Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of construction workers. 

It aims to provide a safety net for workers and their families in times of crisis. 

The scheme is part of the government's larger vision of social security for all workers in the informal sector. 

The implementation of this scheme is expected to reduce the financial burden on families of deceased workers. 

It also aims to promote the well-being of differently-abled construction workers. 

The scheme is a significant step towards improving the living conditions of construction workers in India. 

By providing financial assistance, the government aims to alleviate poverty among the families of construction workers. 

The Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana is a timely intervention in light of the increasing number of accidents in the construction sector. 

The scheme is designed to provide immediate relief and support to those who need it the most. 

It is essential for eligible beneficiaries to be aware of the application process and the required documentation. 

Awareness campaigns may be conducted by state welfare boards to ensure that workers and their families know about the scheme. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries without any delays.

It highlights the importance of social security measures for vulnerable populations in the workforce. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the lives of many families across the country.

By supporting the families of deceased workers and differently-abled individuals, the government aims to foster a sense of security and stability.
